description.value: This magitech device is calibrated to detect fluctuations in planar energies found inside the Ghost Levels. While carrying this item, you gain a +1 item bonus to Perception checks to find magical traps, to AC against attacks made by magical traps, and to saves against magical traps. Even if you aren't Searching, you get a check to find magical traps that normally requires you to be Searching. You cannot disable traps without the otherwise required proficiency.
